```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(spDataLarge)
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(terra)
```

```{r}
dem <- terra::rast(system.file("raster/dem.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
landsat <- terra::rast(system.file("raster/landsat.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
srtm <- terra::rast(system.file("raster/srtm.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
```

```{r}
# Use terra:: so R doesn't fall back to base hist()/boxplot(), which can't read a SpatRaster
terra::hist(dem,
            main = "Digital Elevation Model Distribution",
            xlab = "Value")
#stars
#dem_values <- as.vector(dem[[1]])
# hist(dem_values, 
#main = 'digital elevation model distribution, xlab = 'value)

terra::boxplot(dem,
               main = "Digital Elevation Model Distribution",
               ylab = "Value")

```


```{r}
# Define a reclassification matrix
rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, 300, 0, # values -Inf to 300 = 0
                300, 500, 1,  # values 300 to 500 = 1
                500, Inf, 2), # values 500 to Inf = 2
              ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1 or 2
dem_rcl <- terra::classify(dem, rcl = rcl)

# stars
# dem_rcl <- cut(dem, breaks = c(-Inf, 300, 500, Inf), labels = c('low', 'medium', 'high'))

# Assign labels to the numerical categories

# Old version: works with newer terra, but older versions (e.g., 1.7) error with
# "[set.cats] the first column of 'value' must be numeric" because they don't accept a tibble
# levels(dem_rcl) <- tibble::tibble(id = 0:2,
#                                   cats = c("low", "medium", "high"))

# New version: a plain data.frame works with both older and newer terra
levels(dem_rcl) <- data.frame(id = 0:2,
                              cats = c("low", "medium", "high"))

# Calculate mean elevation for each category using original DEM values
elevation_mean <- terra::zonal(dem, dem_rcl, fun = "mean")
elevation_mean
```

```{r}
scale_factor <- 0.0000275
offset <- 0.2

scale_function <- function(x) {
  x * scale_factor + offset
}

landsat_scaled <- terra::app(landsat, fun = scale_function)
```

```{r}
ndwi_fun <- function(green, nir){
    (green - nir)/(green + nir)
}

ndvi_fun <- function(nir, red){
  (nir - red)/(nir + red)
}

ndwi_rast <- terra::lapp(landsat_scaled[[c(2, 4)]],
                         fun = ndwi_fun)

ndvi_rast <- terra::lapp(landsat_scaled[[c(4, 3)]],
                         fun = ndvi_fun)

plot(ndwi_rast,
     main = "Zion National Park NDWI")

plot(ndvi_rast, 
    main = 'Zion National Park NDVI')
```

```{r}
combined <- c(ndwi_rast, ndvi_rast)
plot(combined, main = c("NDVI", "NDWI"))

terra::layerCor(combined, fun = cor)
```

```{r}
plot(srtm)
```

```{r}
rast_template <- terra::rast(terra::ext(srtm), res = 0.01) # Create empty template
srtm_resampl1 <- terra::resample(srtm, y = rast_template, method = "bilinear")
srtm_resampl2 <- terra::resample(srtm, y = rast_template, method = "near")
srtm_resampl3 <- terra::resample(srtm, y = rast_template, method = "cubic")
srtm_resampl4 <- terra::resample(srtm, y = rast_template, method = "cubicspline")
srtm_resampl5 <- terra::resample(srtm, y = rast_template, method = "lanczos")

srtm_resampl_all <- c(srtm_resampl1, srtm_resampl2, srtm_resampl3, srtm_resampl4, srtm_resampl5)
labs <- c("Bilinear", "Near", "Cubic", "Cubic Spline", "Lanczos")

plot(srtm_resampl_all, main = labs)
```





similiar plots, but with the stars package
```{r}
#stars
dem_stars <- stars::read_stars(system.file("raster/dem.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
landsat_stars <- stars::read_stars(system.file("raster/landsat.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
srtm_stars <- stars::read_stars(system.file("raster/srtm.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))

dem_values_stars <- as.vector(dem[[1]])
hist(dem_values_stars, 
main = 'digital elevation model distribution', xlab = 'value')

boxplot(dem_values_stars, ylab = 'value')
# Calculate mean elevation for each category using original DEM values
# Reclassify by cutting values into intervals, returning a factor raster

dem_rcl_stars <- cut(dem_stars,
               breaks = c(-Inf, 300, 500, Inf), # -Inf to 300, 300 to 500, 500 to Inf
               labels = c("low", "medium", "high"))

plot(dem_rcl_stars, main = "Reclassified elevation")

elevation_mean_stars <- tibble(elevation = as.vector(dem_stars[[1]]),
                         cats = factor(as.vector(dem_rcl_stars[[1]]), levels = levels(dem_rcl_stars[[1]]))) |> 
  group_by(cats) |> 
  summarise(mean_elevation = mean(elevation, na.rm = TRUE))
elevation_mean_stars
```

```{r}
class(srtm_stars)
```

```{r}
# Polygonize the reclassified raster, merging cells of the same class
dem_polys <- sf::st_as_sf(dem_rcl_stars, merge = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(dem.tif) %>%
  summarise() # Dissolve into one (multi)polygon per class
```
